title: Oracle high-dimensional $M$-estimation using smooth reparameterization for sparsity
summary: This paper establishes a unified non-linear regularization framework for high-dimensional $M$-estimation, encompassing both linear regression and Cox's proportional hazards models. Rather than relying on traditional additive non-convex penalties, the proposed paradigm embeds sparsity directly into the parameter mapping using a smooth ($C^2$) component-wise ReParametrization map for Sparsity (RePS).
